## Testing Mode
GREEN

## TDD Exemption
Exemption criterion 3 — static asset / non-executable instruction file. `code-reviewer-arbiter.md` is an LLM agent definition (a non-executable `.md` instruction file in `plugins/dso/agents/`). Per behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5, no deterministic behavioral test can be written for this file's LLM instruction-following behavior. Structural tests (file existence, schema validation) are not applicable here since the output schema is validated via the Python consumer in T4. A change-detector `test -f` is explicitly prohibited by Rule 5.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: code-reviewer-arbiter.md rewrites the ruling schema: output contains exactly one of BLOCK, DEFER, or DROP per finding group; no free-form verdict strings
- DD2: Per-Finding Processing Protocol implemented: arbiter processes findings one at a time, assigns ruling per finding, then aggregates; no batch short-circuits that skip individual finding evaluation
- DD3: BLOCK-gate uses AND-logic: a BLOCK ruling is only issued when ALL of the following are true: (a) severity is critical or important, (b) defense was rejected or absent, (c) cycle <= max_cycles
- DD4: CoVe soft-cap fallback: when cycle count exceeds max_cycles, arbiter must emit DEFER (not BLOCK) for remaining unresolved findings; behavior documented in ruling schema

## Overview
Rewrite the entire `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md` agent definition from the old severity-dispute arbiter role to the new cycle-end ruling role.

### Old role (to be removed completely)
- Adjudicates severity disputes between reviewer and defense (per-finding, RESUSTAIN_OF relation)
- Output schema: SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY | ACCEPT_DEFENSE | DOWNGRADE_TO_<severity>
- Input: single finding + single prior defense + diff

### New role
- Cycle-end consolidation arbiter: called at end of cycle K (when cycle >= max_cycles or adaptive-stability halt)
- Input: full list of unresolved findings + defenses per finding + diff + cycle metadata (cycle_num, max_cycles, schema_version)
- Output per finding: {finding_index, ruling: BLOCK|DEFER|DROP, rationale, impact_class, schema_version}
- Processing: Per-Finding Processing Protocol — process each finding individually; no batch short-circuits

### BLOCK-gate AND-logic (must be documented verbatim in agent file)
A BLOCK ruling requires ALL of:
1. severity in {critical, important}
2. defense was rejected OR absent
3. cycle_num <= max_cycles

### CoVe soft-cap fallback
When cycle_num > max_cycles: emit DEFER (not BLOCK) for all remaining unresolved findings. This is the CoVe soft-cap: the loop has cycled beyond its bound; force convergence.

### schema_version
Output must include `schema_version` matching the cycle-ledger schema version convention (see S2/aead-ae88 cycle-ledger.json: `schema_version: "1.0.0"`). Each finding's ruling output includes `"schema_version": "1.0.0"`.

### DROP ruling
A finding receives DROP when: severity is minor or style AND the finding was not re-raised from a prior cycle. Cycle-end arbiter may DROP minor/style findings that were originally raised as NEW_INTRODUCED and not contested across cycles.

## File Impact
- `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md` — MODIFY (complete rewrite)

## Implementation Steps
1. Replace the frontmatter description: "Arbiter (Opus): cycle-end ruling — BLOCK/DEFER/DROP per finding at cycle boundary."
2. Rewrite Context section: new role, inputs (finding list, defenses, diff, cycle metadata), outputs
3. Rewrite Mandatory Output Schema — remove SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY, ACCEPT_DEFENSE, DOWNGRADE_TO_* schemas; add BLOCK/DEFER/DROP schemas with schema_version field
4. Document Per-Finding Processing Protocol as an explicit section
5. Document BLOCK-gate AND-logic as explicit rules (verbatim conditions a/b/c)
6. Document CoVe soft-cap fallback as an explicit rule
7. Add Anti-Compromise Rules for the new schema (exhaustiveness, no free-form verdicts, schema_version required)
8. Remove Anti-Compromise Rules for old schema (DOWNGRADE_TO constraints, no severity inflation)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/ -x 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] BLOCK/DEFER/DROP appear in the agent file
  Verify: grep -c "BLOCK\|DEFER\|DROP" plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md | awk '{exit ($1 < 3)}'
- [ ] No old verdict strings remain in the agent file
  Verify: ! grep -q "SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY\|ACCEPT_DEFENSE\|DOWNGRADE_TO" plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md
- [ ] Per-Finding Processing Protocol section exists
  Verify: grep -q "Per-Finding Processing Protocol" plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md
- [ ] BLOCK-gate AND-logic is documented
  Verify: grep -q "AND-logic\|AND logic\|all.*following" plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md
- [ ] schema_version field appears in the output schema
  Verify: grep -q "schema_version" plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
